entry.content:
Links: musictech.com

Apple has acquired Swiss AI audio startup Samplab, integrating its polyphonic note-editing and stem-separation technology. Samplab's software utilizes machine learning to transcribe polyphonic recordings into editable MIDI notes while preserving the original timbre, streamlining sample manipulation and remixing workflows.

The acquisition is anticipated to strengthen Apple's Logic Pro and potentially influence its broader creator application suite, including Logic for iPad and Final Cut Pro. By absorbing these capabilities, Apple positions its digital audio workstation to better compete with rival DAWs that feature advanced note-level and polyphonic audio editing.
